paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training set.
model_annotation: The figure displays two line plots illustrating the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B across different training sets, with the top plot labeled "Easy Training Set" and the bottom plot labeled "Hard Training Set." In both plots, the x-axis represents the number of training steps, ranging from 0 to 500, with labeled ticks at intervals of 100. The y-axis represents training rewards, scaled from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, with labeled ticks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot, the Llama-On-Policy-Easy (blue line) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red line) both start at a training reward of approximately 0.0 and increase over steps, with the red line consistently achieving higher rewards than the blue line, both plateauing near a reward of 0.4. In the bottom plot, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard (blue line) starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and remains near 0.0 across all steps, while the Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line) begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, rises to about 0.15 by step 200, and continues to increase, reaching a reward of approximately 0.2 by step 500.
